name: tags_create
description: Create a custom project tag, or a custom review status with kind=status. Before creating a status, get an explicit color and icon choice from the user; never choose defaults. Same as the feed footer: owner/admin/editor (`canCreate`). Pass projectReference from folders_list (project or folder ref by name — folder refs resolve to root project; UI folder irrelevant). The four system statuses already exist — never recreate those. On a general section or outside a project, ask which project and wait; never default to the personal project (project_default), even if it is the only one. The Spaces tool and the Spaces home may use the project of that space. Inside a project, use it. On duplicate/limit errors reuse existing — do not retry.

color.description: Hex color, e.g. #60A5FA. Required for kind=status after the user chooses it; default #60A5FA for a tag.

icon.description: Required for kind=status after the user chooses it. Map Needs review=half, In progress=threeQuarters, Approved/check=complete, Rejected/cross=rejected. Ignored on a tag.

kind.description: status creates a custom review status. Omit for a tag.
